title: scrophularia auriculata subsp. lyrata
intro: Scrophularia auriculata subsp. lyrata, commonly known as Bear's Ears, is a plant species belonging to the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia auriculata subsp. lyrata include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
